ingest_disposition.reason: Inbox was already quiescent after the accounted Stop-hook packet; this turn performs direct pinned-donor source closure on the retrieval identity boundary and refines the existing Triggerword-4 handoff.

direct_source_atoms.finding: MicroClay.retrieve persists one retrieval_episodes row carrying retrieval_id, turn_id, episode_id, causal_id, session_id, generation and query_hash together with selected memory IDs and entry keys. The durable retrieval row therefore already contains enough internal identity dimensions to avoid a newest-session-row join.

_microclay_schatten deliberately creates a fresh causal_id, turn_id and episode_id per UserPromptSubmit shadow retrieval and passes them into MicroClay.retrieve. The stored turn content is only a system marker; the actual user query is supplied to retrieve and represented by query_hash rather than by that synthetic turn text.

_kognition_richten_hook does not select by retrieval_id, turn_id, causal_id, generation or query_hash. It selects the newest same-session retrieval lacking modell:relevanz feedback, separately reads the last user text from transcript_path, evaluates that text against the selected row's memory IDs, then applies credit to that row. No exact row-to-transcript identity equality is enforced before the model judgment is admitted.

MicroClay._apply_credit is already row-bound: its receipt identity incorporates retrieval_id, causal_id, generation, signal_class and credit; retrieval_feedback stores retrieval_id, causal_id and generation. The reducer can therefore preserve exact retrieval identity if the caller supplies the correct row. The structural defect is upstream candidate selection/rejoin, not a need to replace the reducer or retrieval schema wholesale.

architecture_effect.core_conclusion: Move model relevance out of Stop and create the deferred relevance candidate at the moment the retrieval row is created, when the exact retrieval_id/turn_id/causal_id/generation/query_hash and selected-memory set are already co-present. A later model result must return that same tuple and model runtime/build identity to a deterministic reducer; Stop must not recover ownership by scanning newest same-session rows.
return_verification: fetch retrieval_episodes by retrieval_id, never newest session row
require equality of turn_id, causal_id, generation and query_hash against the candidate envelope
require candidate/result generation and model runtime identity to match the admitted request
reject stale, duplicate, unknown or mismatched returns before _apply_credit
preserve modell:relevanz as model-derived candidate evidence with no truth/effect/promotion authority
architecture_effect.important_simplification: Because exact retrieval identity already exists in the donor schema and _apply_credit receipt path, Frankenstein 2.0 does not need a second retrieval truth store or a new global identity system for this repair. It needs a typed deferred-work binding that carries existing identities without dropping them.

privacy_and_lifetime_boundary.finding: The current relevance prompt includes user query text plus durable-memory candidate text. Moving work out of Stop must not turn that text into unnecessary durable model memory.
privacy_and_lifetime_boundary.requirement: Prefer local short-lived/bounded payload refs or a transcript-message reference bound to query_hash; durable receipts should retain digests/identity/provenance, not full prompt text unless separately authorized and required.

duplicate_prompt_edge_case.finding: query_hash alone is not an exact event identity because two identical user prompts in one session can share the same hash.
duplicate_prompt_edge_case.requirement: retrieval_id remains the primary join key. If a transcript message must be re-read later, bind a message/event identity or a locally generated submission generation/ordinal in addition to query_hash; never use query_hash alone to choose among repeated identical prompts.

contradictions_preserved: The donor stores strong round-sharp retrieval identity but the Stop relevance path discards it during ownership selection and falls back to newest same-session row plus latest transcript user text.
The reducer receipt is exact-row capable, yet exactness of the durable feedback cannot repair a wrong row chosen upstream.
The top-level no-LLM-in-hook invariant still conflicts with synchronous Stop Ollama inference; this delta does not resolve runtime behavior and grants zero runtime credit.
counterhypotheses: If Claude Code guarantees strictly serialized one-Stop-per-UserPromptSubmit delivery with no reordering, newest-session-row selection may usually work. That guarantee is not enforced by this donor source and does not satisfy the supervisor's required interleaving discriminator.
Using query_hash to bind the latest transcript text may remove many mismatches, but repeated identical prompts remain ambiguous; retrieval_id plus generation remains necessary.

A shared DeferredCausalReturnEnvelope/v1 may be useful across retrieval and voice, but RetrievalRelevanceBinding/v2 remains valid as a subsystem-specific specialization if a shared envelope would add coupling or erase semantics.

required_actions: emit RetrievalRelevanceCandidate from the retrieval-creation path using the exact retrieval row identity instead of recovering ownership in Stop
execute model relevance outside deterministic hook completion authority
on return, fetch by retrieval_id and verify turn_id + causal_id + generation + query_hash + candidate generation before _apply_credit
keep Stop mechanical bookkeeping independent of model availability/latency
do not modify Frank Harness to obtain evidence
triggerword4_handoff.highest_information_discriminator: Create two same-session retrievals, including a repeated-identical-query variant, then force reverse-order relevance completion. PASS only if each modell:relevanz receipt remains attached to its exact retrieval_id/turn/causal/generation and no Stop bookkeeping is skipped.

next_exact_gate: Triggerword-4/external non-provider test lane: implement exact retrieval_id-bound deferred relevance specialization and execute reverse-order same-session plus repeated-identical-query interleaving, while separately testing cognition-disabled/warm/slow/unreachable model conditions and proving deterministic Stop bookkeeping completes.
